freeDeliverablesSection.title: What Do You Get Free — Before Paying a Single Rupee?
freeDeliverablesSection.description: After one consultation call, receive five professional design deliverables absolutely free. These typically cost ₹15,000–₹40,000 in design fees, but you get them at zero cost — whether or not you hire us.

items.title: 2D Layout Plan
items.description: Furniture placement, circulation space, and storage mapped on your floor plan so you know exactly what fits where.

items.title: 3D Design Renders
items.description: Realistic views of your living room, kitchen, and bedrooms so you can judge the design before execution.

items.title: Scope of Work (SOW)
items.description: Every task documented including false ceiling, electrical points, carpentry, painting, and finishing work.

items.title: Materials & Brands Plan
items.description: Complete material specifications including plywood, laminates, hardware, finishes, and recommended brands.

items.title: Itemized Cost Sheet
items.description: Every item priced separately with Good, Better, and Best options so you stay in control of your budget.
